data.one_liner: Performs sentiment analysis on text using the AFINN-165 wordlist and emoji sentiment ranking.
data.what_it_does: Sentiment Dart analyzes blocks of text to evaluate sentiment scores. It cross-checks string tokens and emojis against built-in language wordlists like English, Italian, French, and German, or custom language dictionaries.
use_when: You need to analyze text sentiment or emotional valence in Dart or Flutter.
You want to process text with multi-language support (English, Italian, French, German).
You want to include emoji sentiment in your text scoring.
avoid_when: You require complex machine learning models or deep neural networks for semantic analysis.
strengths: Supports multiple languages out of the box.
weaknesses: Relies on a static wordlist (AFINN-165) rather than advanced AI/ML context evaluation.
